question: What are the most T20I wins by a team against an opposition at a single venue without suffering a defeat?
sql_query: WITH all_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, venue, team1 AS team, team2 AS opponent, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') UNION ALL SELECT match_id, venue, team2, team1, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), venue_records AS ( SELECT team, opponent, venue, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 END) AS wins, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = opponent THEN 1 END) AS losses FROM all_matches GROUP BY team, opponent, venue ) SELECT team, opponent, venue, wins FROM venue_records WHERE losses = 0 AND wins >= 5 ORDER BY wins DESC;

sql_query: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins, COUNT(*) AS total_finals FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id JOIN second_bat sb ON f.match_id = sb.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;
